data.name: PreviewMessage
data.value: Hello, {0}! This message mentions your character.

data.name: CharacterStatus
data.comment: {0}: full character name or localized not-logged-in label.

data.name: PreviewHelp
data.value: Preview the selected character's name and keywords, together with Account keywords. You can type a test message below.

data.name: KeywordsHelp
data.value: Words and phrases match literally, ignoring case, with whole-word boundaries. They share the highlight color. Up to {0} keywords per character and {0} Account keywords.
data.comment: {0}: maximum rules per character or Account list.

data.name: AccountHelp
data.value: Account checked: use this keyword for all characters in this local configuration. Unchecked: use it only for the character and home world selected above.

data.name: CharacterProfileHelp
data.value: Enter the full first and last name and select the character's home world. You can prepare a profile without logging into that character.

data.name: KeywordDuplicate
data.value: This keyword already exists in the selected profile.

data.name: KeywordLimit
data.value: This profile has reached its keyword limit. Edit or remove an existing keyword first.

data.name: KeywordInvalid
data.value: Enter between 1 and {0} characters, without line breaks or control characters.

data.name: KeywordProfileChanged
data.value: The selected profile or keyword is no longer available. Select the profile again.

data.name: NewMessagesOnly
data.value: Changes apply to new messages in native chat and Chat 2. Existing messages keep their previous colors.

data.name: ConfigurationReadError
data.value: Your settings file could not be loaded. Changes apply for this session only. Back up and repair the file, then reload the plugin to enable saving.

data.name: ConfigurationSaveError
data.value: Your settings could not be saved. Check the Dalamud log and the settings folder permissions.

data.name: ModRulesHelp
data.value: Each rule applies temporary settings to its selected Penumbra collection while its conditions match. When they stop matching, or rules are paused or Sidekick is unloaded, its overrides are removed. Permanent settings are kept.

data.name: PenumbraUnavailable
data.value: Penumbra is unavailable or its IPC version is unsupported. You can still edit saved rules.

data.name: ModIntegrationError
data.value: Location or Penumbra integration failed. Check the Dalamud log; pending cleanup will be retried.

data.name: ModRulesStatus
data.comment: {0}: held override count; {1}: skipped mod count.

data.name: LocationUnavailable
data.value: Current location is unavailable (logged out or loading).

data.name: ModRuleOrderHelp
data.value: All conditions in a rule must match. The last matching rule wins for each mod. Toggle inverts its permanent enabled state once per activation. Existing temporary settings from other sources are skipped.

data.name: LocationFiltersHelp
data.value: Any ignores a condition; use 0 for Any in numeric fields. A residential zone includes its house and room interiors; use Housing area to choose indoors or outdoors. Other zones and duties match their exact territory. Instance means the public instance number (1, 2, 3...), not a unique duty session. Housing numbers start at 1; plot detection uses the game's current plot, not a distance radius.

data.name: ModRuleInvalid
data.value: Enter a rule name (1-80 characters), at least one valid condition and 1-64 mods. Up to 64 rules can be saved.

data.name: CurrentLocation
data.value: Current location: {0} · {1} · Instance {2} · Ward {3} · Plot {4} · Room {5}
data.comment: {0}: world; {1}: territory; {2}: public instance (0 when none); {3}: ward; {4}: plot; {5}: room. Unavailable housing values use an em dash.

data.name: ResidentialLocation
data.comment: {0}: residential district name; {1}: current interior territory name.

data.name: MissingCollection
data.value: Saved collection unavailable. Select a replacement

data.name: TargetCollectionHelp
data.value: Select a collection from Penumbra's list, such as Default for housing. Named collections keep their stable ID. Current character collection follows your effective collection. A missing collection is skipped; it never falls back to another target. Changes can affect all actors or assets using the selected collection.

data.name: ModRefreshHelp
data.value: The selected refresh runs after applying and removing an override, once per batch. Redraw all refreshes actors; furniture is separate and Penumbra currently supports indoor furniture only. The refresh target does not change which collection receives the mod settings.

data.name: RefreshListsHelp
data.value: Refresh and retry. Reload mods and collections from Penumbra, then retry skipped rules.

data.name: NoModRules
data.value: No rules yet. Add a rule to choose a location, collection and mods.

data.name: RuleEnabledHelp
data.value: Enable or pause this rule. A paused rule releases its temporary settings.

data.name: RuleDraftHelp
data.value: Changes are applied only after saving. Cancel returns to the list without modifying the saved rule.

data.name: HousingHelp
data.value: Use 0 to ignore a number. Ward and plot start at 1. A residential district includes its interiors; the area selector distinguishes indoors and outdoors.

data.name: NoKeywords
data.value: No keywords for this profile yet.

data.name: FocusToggleHelp
data.value: Use this button or /sk focus to toggle Focus. /sk focus on and /sk focus off also work in macros. Only new message bodies are affected. Your own messages and system messages remain unchanged.

data.name: FocusCriteriaHelp
data.value: Choose a distance, a list of participants, or both. The other authors in the selected channels receive the configured opacity. Settings are shared by characters using this local configuration.

data.name: FocusDistanceHelp
data.value: Distance in yalms (y), from 1 to 300, measured in 3D when a message arrives. Only loaded players have a known position. An identified author outside that area is considered out of range. Moving later does not change old messages.

data.name: FocusParticipantsHelp
data.value: Add nearby players or enter a full character name and home world manually. Checked participants are selected. Visited worlds do not change their identity. Authors that cannot be identified safely remain readable.

data.name: FocusNoCriteria
data.value: All other identified players in the selected channels are dimmed.

data.name: FocusCombinationHelp
data.value: OR keeps nearby players or listed participants readable. AND keeps only listed participants who are also nearby readable.

data.name: FocusOpacityHelp
data.value: From 1% to 100%, with 25% by default. Focus multiplies the alpha of text colors after Sidekick highlighting. Icons, sender names and timestamps are unchanged.

data.name: FocusGameColors
data.value: Dimmed messages use FFXIV channel colors; embedded text colors are preserved.

data.name: FocusUnresolvedColors
data.value: {0} message(s) kept readable because a color could not be resolved.

data.name: FocusChannelsHelp
data.value: Only checked channels are affected. Say and emotes are selected by default. Private messages are optional. System, NPC and GM messages are always preserved.

data.name: FocusNoChannels
data.value: Select a channel to apply Focus.

data.name: FocusNoParticipants
data.value: No saved participants. Select nearby characters or use + to add one manually.

data.name: FocusParticipantDuplicate
data.value: This character is already in the list.

data.name: FocusParticipantLimit
data.value: The list is limited to 64 participants.

data.name: FocusParticipantInvalid
data.value: Enter a valid full character name and select a home world.

data.name: FocusShortCommandUnavailable
data.value: Sidekick: /sk is already registered. Use /sidekick instead.

data.name: FocusCommandUsage
data.value: Sidekick: /sk opens settings; /sk focus [on|off] controls Focus; /sk cpose N selects a pose, starting at 1. /sidekick accepts the same arguments.

data.name: CposeOutOfRange
data.value: Sidekick: for {0}, choose a pose from 1 to {1}.

data.name: CposeBlocked
data.value: Sidekick: cannot change pose right now. Stop moving and finish any current action before trying again.

data.name: CposeUnavailable
data.value: Sidekick: the native change-pose emote could not be identified on this game version.

data.name: CposeCancelled
data.value: Sidekick: pose selection cancelled because the character, area or posture changed.

data.name: CposeNotConfirmed
data.value: Sidekick: the requested pose could not be confirmed. No additional change-pose emotes were sent.

data.name: CposeFailed
data.value: Sidekick: pose selection failed. See /xllog for the technical error.

data.name: CommandsIntro
data.value: Commands for Sidekick and its modules.

data.name: ChatIntro
data.value: Highlights mentions of your current character's first or last name, along with saved words and phrases assigned to a character or the account.

data.name: FocusIntro
data.value: Filters chat by range and/or selected participants by reducing the opacity of unwanted messages.

data.name: ModRulesIntro
data.value: Enable, disable or Toggle mods using profile rules for locations, weather and activity, including modded furniture.

data.name: CommandsAliasesHelp
data.value: /sidekick also accepts every module command shown with /sk below.

data.name: CommandOpen
data.value: Open or close the Sidekick window.

data.name: CommandCposeGeneric
data.value: Select pose N for the current posture, starting at 1.

data.name: CommandsEmotesHelp
data.value: Examples 1 to 7 cover standing poses. The available range depends on your current posture. A number may be unavailable when sitting or lying down; Sidekick then displays the valid range.

data.name: ResetChatHelp
data.value: Enable highlighting and restore its default color. Saved keywords, Focus, Penumbra rules and language are preserved.

data.name: ResetFocusHelp
data.value: Disable Focus and restore its default channels, range, opacity and criteria. Saved participants, chat settings, Penumbra rules and language are preserved.

data.name: RuleProfilesHelp
data.value: Account rules apply to every character using this local configuration. Character profiles use the full name and home world. Selecting a profile only changes the rules being edited.

data.name: RuleProfileInUse
data.value: Move or remove this profile's rules before deleting it.

data.name: RuleProfileInactive
data.value: This profile is not active for the connected character. You can still edit its rules.

data.name: RuleProfileInvalid
data.value: Enter a valid full character name and home world. A profile for that character must not already exist.

data.name: RuleConditionsHelp
data.value: All selected conditions must match. Any ignores a condition. Day is 06:00 to 18:00 Eorzea time; night covers the remaining hours. Swimming includes diving. Changes must remain stable for one second.

data.name: RuleProfileOrderHelp
data.value: Character rules take priority over Account rules. Within a profile, the last matching rule wins.

data.name: GlamourerIntro
data.value: Apply saved Glamourer outfits using character or Account rules based on locations, weather and activity.

data.name: GlamourerRestoreHelp
data.value: Only equipment is applied, without locking the character. When a rule ends, the previous appearance is restored only if it still matches Sidekick's applied state. Manual or other-plugin changes are preserved until the rule is activated again or retried. An offline character can only be restored after it becomes available again while Sidekick remains loaded.

data.name: GlamourerUnavailable
data.value: Glamourer is unavailable or its IPC version is unsupported.

data.name: GlamourerFailed
data.value: Glamourer could not apply or restore an appearance. Use Refresh to retry.

data.name: GlamourerSkipped
data.value: The matching rule was skipped. Check the selected design and any Glamourer lock, then refresh to retry.

data.name: GlamourerPaused
data.value: Appearance changes are paused during combat, cutscenes and GPose.

data.name: GlamourerMissingDesign
data.value: Select a design (saved design may be unavailable)

data.name: GlamourerRuleInvalid
data.value: Enter a rule name, select a design and at least one valid condition.

data.name: RuleMultiSelectionHelp
data.value: Select one or more entries. Any selected entry can match; other rule conditions must also match. Identical names are grouped. A mixed checkbox indicates an older selection that includes only some variants. Choosing Any clears this filter.

data.name: EarlyApplicationHelp
data.value: Attempts to apply mods before the zone loads (e.g. outdoor furniture). Select Default, a residential district, a ward and its division. Leave plot and room on Any, and area on Any or Outdoors.

data.name: EarlyApplicationResult
data.value: Applied during the last loading screen: {0} mod(s)
